description: In a nonempty dense linear order without endpoints, finite sets \(L,U\) admit a point strictly above every member of \(L\) and below every member of \(U\) whenever \(\ell<u\) for every \(\ell\in L,u\in U\). Either bound set may be empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.finite_bounds.{u} {M : Type u} [LinearOrder M] [DenselyOrdered M]
  [NoMinOrder M] [NoMaxOrder M] [Nonempty M] (l u : Finset M) (h : ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ u, a < b) :
  ∃ x, (∀ a ∈ l, a < x) ∧ ∀ b ∈ u, x < b
